about: I'm Paul Zeng, a CS and Applied Mathematics student at UC Berkeley (class of 2029). I came to ML through competitive programming and math, and I care about understanding why methods work, not just that they run. I'm building toward ML for scientific problems, especially physics, while shipping agents and tools on the side.

items: Taking probability (EECS 126), PDEs (Math 126) and Physics 7B, and following Berkeley's machine learning course (CS 189).
Building Second Self, an AI agent that models a person's habits and handles their admin work.
Heading to Immerse the Bay, Stanford's XR hackathon, in November.
